statement: A prerelease path that holds every publish step still moves defaults if the version bump lands on the default branch, because the bump commit is itself a publication to every surface that reads that branch. Making the release driver skip the binaries, the image, the registry, the tap and the floating tag for a release candidate left three defaults moving with the bump alone: a plugin marketplace that serves its plugin from main pinned the candidate, a currency surface that reads a channel record at main went red for the newest final release, and a distribution validator required the README to name an image tag that a candidate never publishes. Rule: before claiming a prerelease moves nothing by default, list every reader of the default branch (marketplaces, verifiers reading ref=main, validators that force prose to match the version), not only the publish steps, and name each one that the bump moves.
